build.qualification: Thirty-three fixed dictionary/input pairs, three immutable dictionary kinds and eleven inputs. Clock-free ledgers separate one-block staging, workspace and dictionary construction/release across stateless, persistent and prefix selections with the same borrowed view. Dictionary snapshots must remain unchanged during every selected call; no handle clone or runtime dictionary allocation is inferred from timing. No measured performance claim before complete qualified builds and the full matrix.

primary_timing.qualification: Per-attempt compression clocks include every codec scratch allocation and release through Global. Stateless, persistent and both prefix schedules borrow the same immutable view and write the same caller destination prepared outside clocks; dictionary construction, full-byte/guard validation and role-routed allocation ledgers remain outside clocks. Prefix rearming is outside or inside the clock exactly as labeled; every attempt starts with the intended selection and ends consumed or persistent. The setup-only batch clock includes loop and black-box overhead and is not a directly subtractive estimate of per-attempt overhead. Equal timer overhead is retained; no universal unsafe benefit, allocator elimination or desktop idleness is claimed.

summary.unit: nanoseconds per operation for compression modes; nanoseconds per 4096-pair batch for setup observations
summary.aggregation: Equal-weight geometric mean of per-pair median latency ratios over thirty nonempty dictionary/input pairs; the three empty-input pairs remain separate. All four compression modes include per-call Global codec scratch and write a caller destination prepared outside clocks; the stateless baseline receives the same borrowed view directly. Coordinator ratios isolate claim/selection machinery; prefix-outside excludes rearming from the compression clock while prefix-inside includes it, so their ratio bounds the rearm cost inside clocks. Setup-only observations time whole 4096-operation arm/observe/clear batches that include loop and black-box overhead and are not a directly subtractive estimate of per-attempt overhead. No confidence intervals or universal speedup claim.

qualification: All 24 safe/isolated/all production feature selections and two independently rebuilt safe/all repeats retain 675 timing samples and 297 role-specific qualification rows per executable: four compression modes (stateless baseline, persistent coordinator, prefix rearming outside and inside the compression clock) plus setup-only arm/observe/clear batch observations whose loop and black-box overhead is included and not directly subtractable. Staging/workspace/dictionary ledgers are outside timings; Global per-call scratch is inside. Every mode borrows the same immutable view, writes the same caller destination and ends in the verified consumed or persistent selection state. Actual process barriers precede campaigns. No universal speedup, desktop idleness, C byte identity or complete codec replacement is claimed.
